// FOOTBALL BACKGROUND REFRESH V1
// Replaces the existing Predict, Chat and Stats backgrounds with three new user-supplied photos.
// Loaded AFTER tab-backgrounds.js so the existing background system remains intact for every other tab.

const FBR_OVERRIDES = {
  'predict': { image: 'data:image/webp;base64,', position: 'center 40%' },
  'chat': { image: 'data:image/webp;base64,', position: 'center 42%' },
  'stats': { image: 'data:image/webp;base64,', position: 'center center' }
};

function fbrActiveTab() {
  return document.querySelector('#nav button[data-v].active')?.dataset?.v
    || document.body.dataset.photoTab
    || '';
}

function fbrApply() {
  const tab = fbrActiveTab();
  const cfg = FBR_OVERRIDES[tab];
  if (!cfg) return;

  const photo = document.getElementById('plp-tab-photo-layer');
  if (!photo) return;

  photo.style.backgroundImage =
    `linear-gradient(rgba(246,246,251,.08),rgba(246,246,251,.18)),url("${cfg.image}")`;
  photo.style.backgroundPosition = `center center, ${cfg.position}`;
  photo.style.backgroundSize = 'cover, cover';
  document.body.dataset.photoTab = tab;
}

let fbrTimer = null;
function fbrSchedule() {
  clearTimeout(fbrTimer);
  fbrTimer = setTimeout(fbrApply, 30);
}

document.addEventListener('click', e => {
  if (e.target.closest?.('#nav button[data-v]')) {
    setTimeout(fbrApply, 70);
    setTimeout(fbrApply, 180);
  }
});

const fbrObserver = new MutationObserver(fbrSchedule);
fbrObserver.observe(document.body, {
  subtree: true,
  attributes: true,
  childList: true,
  attributeFilter: ['class', 'data-photo-tab']
});

window.addEventListener('focus', fbrSchedule);
setTimeout(fbrApply, 250);
setTimeout(fbrApply, 900);
